svg.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Target-state architecture: PCI/PII document redaction on Azure
Upload → OCR → PII/PCI detection → masking → JSON response. Limits from Microsoft docs (Nov 2026). Timings measured with this repo on a 500-page text PDF.
Implemented in languageservice.py today; other components are target state
PDF page list, TIFF frames, image = 1
PROCESSING · Redaction worker (Container Apps or Functions) · fails closed: any error returns no output
Large files: split with pages range
5 docs per request, 1 MB per request
CVV and expiry after their labels
Mask the union of all spans with *
Block if a card number or CVV
Runs once the result is written
Delete raw file and extracted text
Measured: 500-page synthetic bank statement (861 KB text PDF)
Single run, East US, Nov 22 2026. Scanned PDFs not measured; expect slower OCR.
CROSS-CUTTING CONTROLS · every component above is in PCI DSS scope
Entra ID + managed identity (no keys in code)
Key Vault for any remaining secrets
Private endpoints, public network access off
Azure Monitor: no document content in logs
Regression test on every API / model change
